citations.claim: initial total mechanical energy at start
first energy_bound violation exceeds allowed limit

explanation: Vertical stack of 7 elastic (e=1) bodies under gravity with large dt=1/30 accumulates energy via sequential impulse plus positional correction. Near-simultaneous contacts and repeated floor/stack bounces with restitution 1 and coarse substepping inject net mechanical energy until it exceeds E0+10%+5J, with controller work zero so no external work explains the growth.
vision_note: Seven circular bodies remain arranged in a tight vertical column with two upper bodies hovering above a five-body lower stack. From step 700 to 703 the stack shows almost no displacement, bouncing, or dispersal despite the energy_bound violation at step 703.
